findings.title: Moving implementation cost presented as a hardware ceiling
findings.old_claim_summary: The realistic batch-one ceiling is approximately 6.1 tok/s; no direction reaches single-request 10 tok/s.
findings.correction: A sum of incumbent kernel costs bounds that implementation, not all legal dataflows. The later fused real-API direction reaches 8.557 tok/s under its recorded unmatched loading protocol; this is sufficient to reopen architecture, not qualify 10 tok/s.
findings.retained_evidence: Retain measured unroll/split gains; retire 5.5/6.1/6.29 as planning ceilings.
findings.next_action: Qualify one composed fused architecture at the real API.

findings.title: Calibration and checkpoint size promoted to a compulsory traffic bound
findings.old_claim_summary: 18.529 GB / 182.7 GB/s gives a 101.4 ms hardware floor.
findings.correction: The division is a conditional estimate. A read microbenchmark is not a universal bandwidth upper bound, and checkpoint tensor bytes are not independently established mandatory DRAM transactions per step.
findings.retained_evidence: Retain the read calibration and tensor inventory as observations.
findings.next_action: Any bound needs same-workload actual traffic, operations, matched profile and known implementation reconciliation.

findings.title: Opposite DRAM/L2 causal claims from the same indirect timing
findings.old_claim_summary: Requested throughput above read calibration proves L2 absorption; corrected timing proves sixfold real DRAM cost.
findings.correction: Neither conclusion follows without actual transactions/counters or a discriminating control. Source reuse also changes instruction count, occupancy and scheduling. A slower 1 GB benchmark than a 4 GB benchmark does not establish partial L2 assistance.
findings.retained_evidence: Retain measured times and API changes, not the asserted physical traffic cause.
findings.next_action: Use traffic terminology precisely; collect counters only if this cause selects the next implementation.

findings.title: Sixteen-layer totals mislabeled per layer
findings.old_claim_summary: V unique volume 1.31 GB/layer, redundant volume 7.86 GB/layer, time 40.3 ms/layer.
findings.correction: At S=40000, KV heads=4, D=256, BF16: one-layer V=81920000 bytes; all 16 layers=1310720000 bytes; six logical query traversals across all layers=7864320000 bytes. The cited 40.3 ms is likewise an aggregate.
findings.retained_evidence: Ratios can accidentally remain plausible when numerator and denominator both contain the same factor-16 error.
findings.next_action: Label bytes, layer count, memory level and time scope explicitly.

findings.title: Mixed-version denominators and retrospective predictions
findings.old_claim_summary: 100.52 ms is 38% of the 165.2 ms integrated step.
findings.correction: 100.52/165.2=60.847%; 100.52/193=52.083%. Neither is 38%. A prediction revised after observing the result is an updated model, not a successful prior prediction.
findings.retained_evidence: The later matched per-kernel attribution is useful recovery; keep its own artifact and denominator.
findings.next_action: Freeze prediction separately; do not combine costs across binary/protocol versions.

findings.title: Greedy divergence, nondeterminism and capability conflated
findings.old_claim_summary: Changed output attributed directly to nondeterministic few-ULP accumulation.
findings.correction: A before/after string difference proves divergence, not repeatability failure or capability regression. Repeated identical-run divergence supports nondeterminism; same-input tensors/logits and capability evaluation address different questions.
findings.retained_evidence: Later repeated split runs provide stronger repeatability evidence; scalar long-output observations retain their exact context scope.
findings.next_action: Keep separate numerical error, repeated execution, greedy margins and public capability checks.

findings.title: A failed geometry generalized to shared GQA reuse
findings.old_claim_summary: The single-block-per-KV-head failure rejects GQA sharing; atomic merging is its required accuracy tradeoff.
findings.correction: Four-CTA geometry does not reject segmented GQA reuse. The fused candidate uses staged partials and deterministic merge rather than unordered atomic addition.
findings.retained_evidence: Retain negative evidence for the exact single-block geometry and split implementation.
findings.next_action: Select a complete dataflow before scanning parameters; do not inherit an abandoned reduction mechanism.

findings.title: Short or partial validation generalized to product qualification
findings.old_claim_summary: A short-context long-output run or a short oracle closes long-context decode correctness.
findings.correction: P1089/O256 does not cover P40 long output. max-length-128 oracles cannot exercise S>=512 split routing. Text searches for nan/inf are not tensor-finiteness checks.
findings.retained_evidence: Retain each actual oracle and output check at its tested scope.
findings.next_action: Test the selected path and useful long-context output capacity, then qualify the installed composition.

findings.title: New fusion direction must not inherit old overclaim patterns
findings.old_claim_summary: 8.56 tok/s is a production-qualified rate or the 2% screen establishes accuracy.
findings.correction: It is one unprofiled O32 real-API direction with default/lazy baseline versus EAGER candidate. The shadow screen is gross admission, not an approved numerical tolerance. P40 text changed. No new successful vLLM API reference or composed accepted-Prefill runner was obtained.
findings.retained_evidence: Keep the real direction, finite shadow tensors, repeated same-input output and diagnostic profile as bounded evidence.
findings.next_action: Match loading protocol, declare numerical criteria before qualification, compose accepted Prefill and useful output length.

findings.title: Source contracts do not match experimental-path assurances
findings.old_claim_summary: Opt-in split code and sealed CLI imply production route isolation and read-once scratch ownership.
findings.correction: At c4c8a34 both split launchers consult getenv without a BUILD_TESTING guard; public GQA dispatch invokes them. The inspected server environment rejection is confined to the whole-core development branch. Values scratch is process-static cudaMalloc, and two thread groups write each shared tile element.
findings.retained_evidence: This is static source evidence, not a reproduced installed-release failure or measured physical traffic count. Prior cleared-environment timings remain scoped and unaffected.
findings.next_action: Seal low-level dispatch and use explicit engine-owned workspace; do not promote the legacy split implementation.

scope: Historical records preserved byte-for-byte. Active planning corrected. No new performance, accuracy, racecheck or installed-route experiment.
class: explicit retrospective erratum; no runtime promotion
